name: Retro Rollout
description: Imitate a retro game within Mipmap's rules, ship it by the deadline, get a 50% Mips bonus for that project!

name: Steam Spinoff
description:
Recreate a Steam game without an engine, earn it!
You must spend 1 hour per $1 USD that this game costs in your region, but remember, you still get the regular Mips payout on top of this!

name: Renderer Rendition
description: Finish up your renderer, earn a 10% Mips bonus!
